messages:
coralbridge_pm: Hey team — CoralBridge needs to onboard a compact reranker for invoice search (EN/DE). Constraints: redact VAT and IBAN, never persist raw transcripts, EU hosting, HSM for signing. Target go-live in ~3 weeks. Can we support private + HSM day 1?

june_cs: High-level yes. Please share artifact link + tokenizer + sanitized sample set. cc @marco_eval and @ops-bot.

coralbridge_pm: Artifact: https://s3.coralbridge.ai/cb-rerank-v1.tar.gz. Tokenizer included. Samples: 45k invoices, 8k notes. Uploading 300-sample sanitized eval by EOD.

marco_eval: Eval plan: I'll run Redwood Optimize job measuring MAP@10, rerank F1, PII residuals for VAT/IBAN, and determinism. Need 300 labeled examples + 100 adversarial probes. Canary plan: 10%->50%->100% with rollback on any PII_residual > 0 or p95 latency breach.

ops-bot: Ops notes: EU Private + HSM supported. We'll need VPC peering and key provisioning window. A100 recommended for <200ms p95 at 512 tokens. Can disable persistent logs and enable pre-log redaction hook.

coralbridge_pm: Legal wants a redaction demo and signed response proof before sign-off. Also require logs to stay in EU.

june_cs: We'll demo redaction + HSM-signed payload in enablement call. I'll open compliance ticket and schedule enablement Thu 9am CET.

infra-bot: Ticket CS-9010 created: "CoralBridge invoice reranker intake (Private EU + HSM)" 1 assignees: june_cs, marco_eval, ops. Provisioning window estimated: 2026-05-05..2026-05-12.

coralbridge_pm: Thanks — uploading samples now. We'll run an internal scrub first.

june_cs: Marking account health: watch. Renewal risk = medium-high; we'll escalate if post-canary metrics degrade.

marco_eval: Once samples arrive I'll run baseline in 48h and post an acceptance checklist.

coralbridge_pm: Appreciate it, see you on the enablement call.
